### Install

1. Download **`OpenMount-…dmg`** below, open it, and drag **OpenMount** onto **Applications**.
2. **macOS will block it the first time.** That's normal for free apps without a paid Apple developer
   account. Click **Done** (not *Move to Trash*), then open **System Settings › Privacy & Security** and
   click **Open Anyway**.

📖 Step-by-step with screenshots: [Install guide](https://github.com/fjc1991/OpenMount/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md). It's also inside the DMG as *How to open OpenMount*.
